sloka: तेजोविषाणः कुलवंशवंशः कोपप्रसादापरगात्रहस्तः ।इक्ष्वाकुसिंहावगृहीतदेहः सुप्तः क्षितौ रावणगन्धहस्ती ।। ६.११२.११ ।।
transliteration: tejoviṣāṇaḥ kulavaṁśavaṁśaḥ kopaprasādāparagātrahastaḥ ।ikṣvākusiṁhāvagṛhītadehaḥ suptaḥ kṣitau rāvaṇagandhahastī ।। 6.112.11 ।।

translations.english: "Ravana's prowess as tusks, father and grand fathers' race as back of the body, wrath as lower body and graciousness as proboscis, overthrown by a lion in the shape of Ikshvaku race having killed him he is lying asleep thrown down."
translations.hindi: अरे. राक्षसाधम ! हस लोगों के अनजाने चिवशा खी को तू जनस्थ न से हर लाया । अतएब तू शूरवीर तो नहीं है
